build_TransformerEncoderLayer: build a Vision Transformer encoder layer with multihead self-attention and feed-forward network
build_TransformerDecoderLayer: build a cross-attention Transformer decoder layer with optional two-way attention for SAM
create_MLP: create a multi-layer perceptron with configurable input hidden and output dimensions and layer count
create_FFNN: create a feed-forward network with dropout layer scaling and optional identity connection
build_Attention: build a multi-head attention module supporting both self and cross attention with masking
